title: C. Paint the Middle
statement:
You are given n elements numbered from 1 to n, the element i has value a_i and color c_i, initially, c_i = 0 for all i.

The following operation can be applied:

Find the maximum value of ∑limits_{i=1}^nc_i that can be obtained after applying the given operation any number of times.

The first line contains an integer n (3 ≤ n ≤ 2·10^5) — the number of elements.

The second line consists of n integers a_1, a_2, …, a_n (1 ≤ a_i ≤ n), where a_i is the value of the i-th element.

Print a single integer in a line — the maximum value of ∑limits_{i=1}^nc_i that can be obtained after applying the given operation any number of times.

In the first test, it is possible to apply the following operations in order:

Input:
```
7
1 2 1 2 7 4 7
```

Output:
```
2
```

Input:
```
13
1 2 3 2 1 3 3 4 5 5 5 4 7
```

Output:
```
7
```
input:
The first line contains an integer n (3 ≤ n ≤ 2·10^5) — the number of elements.

The second line consists of n integers a_1, a_2, …, a_n (1 ≤ a_i ≤ n), where a_i is the value of the i-th element.
output: Print a single integer in a line — the maximum value of ∑limits_{i=1}^nc_i that can be obtained after applying the given operation any number of times.
